read_ava_csv: create a function that reads an AVA format CSV file and returns boxes, labels, and scores dictionaries
evaluate_ava_from_files: run AVA evaluation given labelmap, groundtruth, detections, and exclusions CSV files
read_labelmap: read a label map file and return a list of category dicts and a set of class IDs
get_ava_eval_data: convert numpy prediction scores and boxes into the official AVA evaluation data format
write_results: write detection results to a CSV file in the official AVA evaluation format
